description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to managing thread bindings in a Matrix context, including binding records, managers, and utility functions for handling binding lifecycle and cache management.

methods.name: resolveBindingKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a binding based on accountId, conversationId, and optional parentConversationId.

methods.name: toSessionBindingTargetKind
methods.description: Converts a MatrixThreadBindingTargetKind to a generic BindingTargetKind.

methods.name: toMatrixBindingTargetKind
methods.description: Converts a generic BindingTargetKind to a MatrixThreadBindingTargetKind.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveBindingExpiry
methods.description: Determines the expiry time and reason for a binding record based on its lifecycle.

methods.name: toSessionBindingRecord
methods.description: Converts a MatrixThreadBindingRecord into a SessionBindingRecord with expiry and metadata.

methods.name: setBindingRecord
methods.description: Stores a binding record in the internal cache.

methods.name: removeBindingRecord
methods.description: Removes a binding record from the internal cache and returns it.

methods.name: listBindingsForAccount
methods.description: Lists all binding records associated with a specific accountId.

methods.name: getMatrixThreadBindingManagerEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the cache entry for a given accountId.

methods.name: setMatrixThreadBindingManagerEntry
methods.description: Sets or updates the cache entry for a given accountId.

methods.name: deleteMatrixThreadBindingManagerEntry
methods.description: Deletes the cache entry for a given accountId.

methods.name: getMatrixThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Retrieves the binding manager instance for a given accountId.

methods.name: setMatrixThreadBindingIdleTimeoutBySessionKey
methods.description: Updates the idle timeout for a session binding identified by session key.

methods.name: setMatrixThreadBindingMaxAgeBySessionKey
methods.description: Updates the max age for a session binding identified by session key.

methods.name: resetMatrixThreadBindingsForTests
methods.description: Clears all binding cache and stops all managers, used for testing.
